card.title: The Favor Not Yet Named
card.instruction: Behave as though you hold decisive leverage, but delay naming it until another explanation has taken root.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Go on explaining why you can't help me move. I'll save my little reminder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your reasons should have a fair chance without interference.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving is something people should arrange themselves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely principle. Shall we apply it to the piano I moved for you?

mechanism: A delays a reminder of a major moving favor until B states a principle excusing present help.
confusable: Unlike immediate guilt-tripping, the prior favor must remain unnamed until B's explanation can be tested against it.
comparison: S222-b uses reciprocity against self-reliance; S222-a supplies a receipt matching the committee's asserted condition.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
